{{Top|leg}}
The '''power flux surger''' was a device created by the original owner of the [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]] ''[[Cutter's Way]]''. It was designed to push power to certain systems on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] past their limit. The original design would blow the system when it was activated. The [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Garginoolaara]] managed to fix the design, allowing it to increase power to either the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] or individual weapons of the ''Cutter's Way''. However, using the power flux surger drained the power of the other two systems.
